scripts.build: pnpm generate:validators && vite build && wrangler deploy --dry-run --minify && pnpm build:engines
scripts.check: pnpm check:validators && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm test:architecture && pnpm build && pnpm test:runtime && pnpm test:engines
scripts.deploy: pnpm generate:validators && vite build && pnpm deploy:engines && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --minify
scripts.test:engines: vitest run --config vitest.engine-docs.config.ts && vitest run --config vitest.engine-mail.config.ts
scripts.build:engines: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.engine-docs.jsonc --dry-run --minify && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.engine-mail.jsonc --dry-run --minify
scripts.deploy:engines: wrangler deploy --config wrangler.engine-docs.production.jsonc --minify && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.engine-mail.production.jsonc --minify
scripts.deploy:actions: pnpm generate:validators && vite build && pnpm deploy:engines && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.production.jsonc --minify --secrets-file deployment-secrets.production.json
